title: tutti device metadata, schema v1
description: Per-device authored metadata that complements per-capture manifests. Lives at evidence/<slug>/device.json. Names the device by its canonical product identity (vendor + product_name) rather than by whatever friendlyName the operator typed into the device's settings panel.

vendor.description: Canonical manufacturer name as the manufacturer brands themselves (EVERSOLO, Sonos, WiiM).

product_name.description: Canonical product name as the manufacturer brands the product (DMP-A6 Master Gen 2). Distinct from the device's friendlyName, which the operator can customise (DMP-A6(livingroom)) and which therefore leaks setup details.

tagline.description: One short sentence describing what the product is. Optional.

discontinued.description: Set true when the manufacturer no longer sells the product. The site flags discontinued devices so contributors don't expect firmware updates that aren't coming.

music_sources.description: Music backends that contributors have actually used with this device (Navidrome, Subsonic, Plex, Roon, Spotify Connect, etc.). Soft signal, not a guarantee. Lets a reader scanning the corpus answer 'will my Navidrome library work with this device?' at a glance.

links.description: Outbound links for someone troubleshooting the device. All optional; the site renders only the keys actually present.

manufacturer.description: Primary product page on the manufacturer's site.

support.description: Support / contact page for the product.

firmware.description: Firmware downloads or release notes page.

purchase.description: A current purchase page; useful for reproducing a capture against a fresh unit.
